children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Connect metrics, logs, events, audit records, and notifications into an actionable signal path with bounded retention.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Every alert needs an owner, duration, severity, notification route, and tested runbook—not just a threshold.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Label every signal with cluster, namespace, resource UID, and synchronized time while keeping component boundaries visible.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Scrape documented API, operator, agent, and relay tunnel metric endpoints.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Collect API, operator, agent, and game logs separately.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Export Kubernetes events and tamper-evident audit records.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Cover control-plane health, reconciliation, fleet states, capacity, storage, backups, credentials, and source synchronization.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Dashboard availability, latency, errors, queues, fleet, and storage.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Alert on stuck/failed work, capacity, DB, certs, backups, sources, relay health, and performance (v0.4.0).

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Attach severity, owner, silence policy, objective, and runbook URL.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Bound cardinality, access, redaction, encryption, and cost; preserve evidence before restarts or rotation.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Metrics + events + component logs + audit with shared identity/time

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Every alert → threshold/duration + severity + owner + route + runbook

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Test alert delivery, cert expiry, backup/DB failure, evidence export
